hola.dash:
Window MiVentana
  title "Hola Dash"
  width 400
  height 150
end

Main
  MiVentana.open
  EventLoop
    On Close
      Print "Adiós!"
      Stop
    end
  end
end

mui_hola.dash:
const ID_SALUDA = 1
const ID_LIMPIA = 2

Main
    if mui_app_begin("Hola MUI", "HOLAMUI") == 0
        Print "No se puede usar MUI"
    else
        win = mui_window_begin("Hola MUI", 1)
            saludo = mui_text("\33cPulsa un botón")
            mui_hgroup_begin()
                saluda = mui_button("_Saluda")
                limpia = mui_button("_Limpia")
            mui_group_end()
        mui_window_end()
        mui_on_press(saluda, ID_SALUDA)
        mui_on_press(limpia, ID_LIMPIA)
        mui_window_open(win)

        veces = 0
        while true
            ev = mui_wait_event()
            if ev == -1
                break
            end
            if ev == ID_SALUDA
                veces = veces + 1
                Print "Hola número #{veces}"
            end
            if ev == ID_LIMPIA
                veces = 0
                Print "A cero"
            end
        end
        mui_app_end()
    end
end

gravedad.dash:
Window Caja
    title "Gravedad con Fixed"
    width 320
    height 200
end

const SUELO = 180

struct Bola
    x: Fixed
    y: Fixed
    vx: Fixed
    vy: Fixed
    color: Int

    func mover(g: Fixed)
        self.vy = self.vy + g
        self.x = self.x + self.vx
        self.y = self.y + self.vy
        if self.y > SUELO
            self.y = SUELO
            self.vy = -self.vy * Fixed(0.85)       # loses some speed at each bounce
        end
        if self.x < 8 or self.x > 300
            self.vx = -self.vx
        end
    end

    func dibujar()
        gfx_pen(self.color)
        gfx_circle_fill(Int(self.x), Int(self.y), 6)
    end
end

Main
    Caja.open
    g = Fixed(0.35)
    bolas = [Bola(20, 10, Fixed(1.5), 0, 1), Bola(60, 30, Fixed(-1.25), 0, 2),
             Bola(110, 5, Fixed(0.75), 0, 3), Bola(160, 50, Fixed(2.2), 0, 1),
             Bola(220, 20, Fixed(-0.6), 0, 2), Bola(280, 40, Fixed(1.1), 0, 3)]
    corriendo = true
    while corriendo
        for b in bolas
            gfx_pen(0)
            gfx_circle_fill(Int(b.x), Int(b.y), 6)
            b.mover(g)
            b.dibujar()
        end
        wait_vblank()
        if window_check_close()
            corriendo = false
        end
    end
end
